checks: Three explicit CLI phases upload/readback/publish; publish requires reviewed candidate SHA and separate --publish-ack.
Upload requires exact forthcoming stdout path, full ToolResponse folder identity, and entire ordered upload result success with actual version including zero.
No automatic retry: fresh phase directory, helper directory, saved full input, intent/attempt and failure records; unknown remote outcome requires root reconciliation.
Every helper uses original external_step with exact intent argv/cwd/stdin, successful actual WAIT4 exit and matching stdout/stderr descriptors.
Readback checks original prepared READBACK_PLAN per-item transfer descriptor/remote version/helper argv/entire external_step argv and then passes that exact argv.
ACK candidate-only phase stops before publication; explicit publish verifies exact copied ACK bytes and leaves actual ACK_VERIFIED acceptance to original supervisor.
START_POLICY exact supervisor identity plus /proc namespace and original 43200-second deadline checked between helpers.
Terminal supervisor or mismatched current request/stage/source pins rejects further work.
limitations: Static review only; actual future tool response and running supervisor metadata still must pass runtime gates.
Only actual supervisor ACK_VERIFIED establishes acceptance.
No claim about remote work success from process exit alone.
scope: Read-only source review, no production phase invoked, no remote operation, no ACK publication.
